mapper.sql: id, course_id, course_name, credits, teacher_id, course_day, course_time, course_type, major_id, academic_year, semester
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO courses(course_id, course_name, credits, teacher_id, course_day, course_time, course_type, major_id, academic_year, semester) VALUES(#{courseId}, #{courseName}, #{credits}, #{teacherId}, #{courseDay}, #{courseTime}, #{courseType}, #{majorId}, #{academicYear}, #{semester})
mapper.update: UPDATE courses SET course_id = #{courseId}, course_name = #{courseName}, credits = #{credits}, teacher_id = #{teacherId}, course_day = #{courseDay}, course_time = #{courseTime}, course_type = #{courseType}, major_id = #{majorId}, academic_year = #{academicYear}, semester = #{semester} WHERE id = #{id}
